newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends weaker v dlr, new domestic factors seen.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends weaker v dlr, new domestic factors seen.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended weaker versus the dollar on the inter-bank forex market as the US unit rallied in late European trade, dealers said on Monday.
The forint closed at 164.53/58 to the dollar, compared to an opening level of 164.30.
"The dollar/mark cross dictated things again," said Balazs Benczedi of West LB Hungaria. "The forint firmed in early trade but fell away at the end."
Benczedi said the current quiet domestic picture could change on Wednesday when banks have to replenish their reserves at the end of the current reserve period.

"The banks shifted quite a lot of funds to the national bank on December 30 when it cut its one-month reverse repo rates," he said. "That money is tied up so they may need to come to the spot forex market to top up their reserves."
This could move the forint 30 pips below the bid, he said
The Swiss franc once again dominated currency futures trade on the Budapest Commodity Exchange, accounting for two-thirds of the 5.22 billion forints turnover.
The Swiss franc, sterling, mark and yen fell for most contracts while the dollar and lira rose and the Ecu was steady. -- Duncan Shiels, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4048
